notes.text: The running timer now shows in the menu bar, so you can keep an eye on it without bringing the window forward.
Added a compact mode that shrinks the window to just the dial.
The dial redraws far less often when the window is in the background, which is easier on battery.
Fixed the timer drifting by a second or two after the Mac woke from sleep.
You can now set a grace period per app, so a quick switch away and back does not ask for your fingerprint again.
The unlock prompt appears noticeably faster on Apple silicon.
Fixed protection not re-arming after a locked app was force quit.
Fixed a crash when starting a timer while another one was already finishing.
The window no longer forgets its position on a second display.
Locky Mocky is out. Protect any Mac app behind Touch ID, with a passcode fallback and nothing leaving your machine.
